openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Volopa OOP Expenses API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: API for managing Out-of-Pocket expenses with user permission management and CSV batch upload
servers:
  - url: https://api.volopa.com/api/v1
    description: Production server
components:
  securitySchemes:
    OAuth2:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: /oauth/token
          scopes: {}
  schemas:
    PocketExpense:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        uuid:
          type: string
        date:
          type: string
          format: date
        merchant_name:
          type: string
        amount:
          type: number
        currency:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [draft, submitted, approved, rejected]
    UserFeaturePermission:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        user_id:
          type: integer
        feature_id:
          type: integer
        is_enabled:
          type: boolean
    UploadResult:
      type: object
      properties:
        upload_id:
          type: string
        total_records:
          type: integer
        valid_records:
          type: integer
        validation_errors:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
security:
  - OAuth2: []
paths:
  /pocket-expenses:
    get:
      summary: List user expenses
      responses:
        200:
          description: Paginated expense list
    post:
      summary: Create new expense
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PocketExpense'
      responses:
        201:
          description: Expense created
  /pocket-expenses/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get expense details
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        200:
          description: Expense details
    put:
      summary: Update expense
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        200:
          description: Expense updated
    delete:
      summary: Delete expense
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        204:
          description: Expense deleted
  /user-feature-permissions:
    get:
      summary: List user permissions
      responses:
        200:
          description: Permission list
    post:
      summary: Grant permission
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserFeaturePermission'
      responses:
        201:
          description: Permission granted
  /user-feature-permissions/{id}:
    delete:
      summary: Revoke permission
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        204:
          description: Permission revoked
  /uploads/pocket-expense/csv:
    post:
      summary: Upload expense CSV
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                target_user_id:
                  type: integer
      responses:
        200:
          description: Upload processed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UploadResult'
        422:
          description: Validation failed
Shared Knowledge: All controllers use thin design pattern delegating to services. FXConversionService provides wallet currency integration with 30-day lookback. PocketExpenseCSVValidator performs atomic validation with preloaded reference data. All models use explicit Eloquent relationships with proper foreign key constraints. API Resources hide internal model fields and provide consistent response format. Queue jobs handle background processing for CSV imports. Policies enforce hierarchical RBAC based on user roles and delegation rights.
Anything UNCLEAR: Several implementation details require clarification: (1) The specific notification channel for batch upload completion affects ProcessExpenseUpload job implementation. (2) Whether FX conversion reuses existing platform service infrastructure or requires new integration. (3) The exact audit logging mechanism for permission operations. (4) ClientFeatures model query pattern to check OOP feature enablement (feature_id = 16). (5) Table naming conventions showing both singular and plural forms. (6) Soft delete pattern preference between flag-based and Laravel SoftDeletes. These decisions may require platform architecture team input for consistency with existing Volopa infrastructure.
